label: Anti-GBM disease
summary: Bounded anti-GBM autoimmunity to alpha3/alpha5 type IV collagen NC1 epitopes, HLA-restricted T-cell responses, antibody-mediated renal and pulmonary injury; human observations and experimental models remain distinct. Excludes Alport post-transplant nephritis and atypical seronegative disease.
query: (TITLE_ABS:"anti-glomerular basement membrane" OR TITLE_ABS:Goodpasture OR ((TITLE_ABS:"anti-GBM") AND (TITLE_ABS:glomerulonephritis OR TITLE_ABS:glomerular OR TITLE_ABS:nephritis))) NOT (TITLE_ABS:glioblastoma OR TITLE_ABS:glioma)
